notes: ὁ takes the single relativizer *who* under rule 90, the participle keeping its own verb; no head noun is expressed, so rule 31 does not compete.

The supplied *to be borne* is kept on μαρτύριον under rule 92 rather than on the dative time phrase; the article keeps its bare *the* and nothing else in the appositional phrase is left unspent to carry the supplied words.
καιροῖς takes *in … times* discontinuously under rules 15 and 21, and ἰδίοις takes *its own* under rule 47's anarthrous clause, no article competing for the possessive.
